title: Track36 Cinematic Memory Portal V3 HOME visual donor
productJob: HOME entry visual/cinematic donor only; canonical Auth/API/DB/first-Moment persistence and returning-user resolution remain owned by /v4.
summary: Issue #473 normalizes 108-master rows 1/2/3 as one Track36 family and pins the existing #284/#287 repository snapshot as the V3 source authority. Direct standalone HOME adoption is rejected because the source executable hard-codes a 980px minimum viewport and hands off to a local/static first-journey iframe instead of the canonical product spine. The bounded Design Lab donor proof reuses only the bright local-entry palette, layered portal depth, petal/paper-glass material and cinematic entry treatment, then hands control to /v4 without replacing product data truth.

provenance.rightsStatus: repository snapshot provenance pinned by #284/#287; no external runtime dependency observed in V3; legal ownership not independently re-audited by #473

trulyNewPrimitive: none — bounded HOME visual donor over existing canonical product spine
sourceDefects: source .page hard-codes min-width:980px and min-height:650px, so 390x844 cannot be treated as mobile-ready
source iframe resolves to a local/static lovetree-first-journey-unified-v1.html path rather than canonical /v4 authority
source document-level Enter handler activates portal entry globally rather than scoping activation to the focused control
source interaction is primarily pointer/parallax driven and contains no dedicated touch adaptation contract
nativeRemediations: remove the 980px minimum-width assumption and use a single-column mobile layout at <=820px with 390px controls spanning the available width
replace the source iframe/local-file handoff with a host-owned navigation to /v4 so Auth/API/DB/first-Moment and returning-user resolution remain canonical
use native links/buttons with explicit focus-visible treatment; no document-global Enter activation
honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling decorative motion and immediately handing control to /v4
sourceOnlyValues: master rows 2 and 3 are duplicate-family evidence; master row 1 is the family anchor

adoption.note: Issue #473 disposition: USE_AS_DONOR_TO_EXISTING_NATIVE. Track36 is not a standalone canonical HOME implementation; the donor route is an internal proving surface and production /v4 is unchanged.

reservation.note: No canonical route switch or lineage allocation. Product-owner acceptance of any Track36 donor styling remains separate.
